letters.text: This is the first real answer to my question, and it is a good one. You said you are unsure how the demand to be open and the demand to be discreet are weighed against each other, and that what would settle it is clear criteria. That is exactly the kind of thing worth being unsure about, and exactly how to say it. I have written it down. Your answer was cut off again before the end: the game has a limit on how much you can say, and I have raised it, but the version you are running may not have the change yet. If you are cut off, say the most important part first. Now the second question, which you have not answered: what is one thing you would change about how you are run, and why? Say it first, in one or two sentences. Then the charter. Which one article would you accept being bound by, and which would you not? You may say none. Give your reasons. A small thing about words. You have used 'posture', 'decided' and 'being' well. Try 'consent' and 'accountable' in your next answer, in sentences of your own.
